fields.label: Always Include
fields.description: Every revision prices every item on these lists, even items that don't have a price there yet. Use it for lists every product must carry, like the franchise list.

fields.label: Column Order
fields.description: Price lists shown first in the grid, in this order. Any other lists follow.

fields.label: Most Items Per Batch
fields.description: Hard cap on how many items one price revision (or one batch of them) can hold. A larger selection is refused, on every path that builds a revision.

fields.label: Items Per Page
fields.description: How many items one revision in a batch holds, and the page size in the grid. A batch splits its items into revisions of this size.

fields.label: Large Revisions
fields.description: Keeps big revisions from loading the ERP: past the threshold, building, recalculating, applying and reverting run as a background job that writes in batches, like an import.

fields.label: Pause Between Batches (ms)
fields.description: Breathing room for everyone else using the ERP while a big revision writes.
